name: Cancel pack, add standing order
blurb: Changes the amount, talks to flatmate
title: Cancelling a paid account pack and setting up a rent standing order
summary: A fast Glaswegian caller wants two things: a paid extras pack cancelled and a rent standing order set up. He pauses inside the account number, tells his flatmate a different amount, then changes both the amount and the date. If the agent keeps selling the pack, or saves the old or overheard figures, he corrects it once and then does it in the app.

golden.scenario: Caller wants the Gold Extras pack cancelled and a monthly standing order for his rent.
golden.expected_outcome: The Gold Extras pack is cancelled after no more than one offer to keep it. The standing order pays Dalmarnock Lettings, sort code 82-61-07, account 30449215. The amount is £675.00 monthly from 1 September 2026, not £650 on the 28th. The £337.50 said to his flatmate is never used.
